task_summary: Captured 8 uncaptured auxiliary/utility application UI screens in Light Mode (1440x900) via Playwright without mutating the database, added Section 4.2.5.5 and Figures 4.35–4.42 (468.0x293.0 pt centered, bold Fig prefixes, explicit zero first-line indent) to Google Doc 19isUvaVR4WcRnkHi2piN_FeadsEGzquBw_cuQbmggCw, updated cross-references (34 -> 42 figures across Sections 4.1.2, 4.1.3, 4.2.5, 5.1), appended TOC 4.2.5.5 + List of Figures rows (Figs 4.34–4.42 exact printed pages 174–182), updated shifted TOC pages (5 SUMMARY..Appendix C), and visually inspected all exported PDF pages.
lessons_learned: Always pass batch raw updateParagraphStyle with indentFirstLine=0 PT, indentStart=0 PT, indentEnd=0 PT when inserting paragraphs after headings in docs whose NORMAL_TEXT named style defaults to 36 PT first-line indent, otherwise 468pt centered screenshots shift right by 36pt and clip the right page edge.
Never pass literal newline characters inside command-line arguments to gdocs.CMD on Windows; always use file-based -f JSON batch/sed operations.
Set alignment=START on figure discussions containing long unbroken route strings like (/projects/:projectId/documents/:docIdOrType) to avoid extreme word spacing under JUSTIFIED alignment.
